baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 1, 3-5 move from deliberate taking and apartness through blocked access to a sending directed toward Mary.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mary actively establishes a human-facing exclusion, while the subsequent dispatch releases an agent toward her and lets it appear on her side of that exclusion. The barrier regulates access by relation and source; it is not simply erased.

activation_trace.role: Making something for oneself marks the enclosure as Mary's deliberate arrangement.
Otherness and separation restrict the barrier's social target to those apart from whom she placed it.
Prevention of access supplies the operative boundary.
Dispatch as release, in contrast with restraint, supplies the crossing movement toward her.
A fashioned presentation locates the resulting appearance inside the newly bounded encounter.

changed_reading.before: Mary hides and then receives a visitor.
changed_reading.after: Mary constructs a selective access boundary; a dispatch from another source enters the bounded encounter without making her act of seclusion meaningless.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 7-11 join spirit, representation, human surface, and complete formation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A life-bearing source is rendered in a coherent human-facing presentation. The sequence distinguishes what is sent from the form in which it becomes perceptible, so human appearance functions as an interface rather than automatically defining source or identity.

activation_trace.role: The life-bearing spirit supplies the source that is presented through a bodily form.
A fashioned image supplies mediation between source and visible appearance.
The exposed human surface makes the presentation sensibly legible.
Straight and complete formation makes the presentation coherent rather than fragmentary.

changed_reading.before: The spirit simply turns into a man.
changed_reading.after: The sent spirit becomes available through a complete human-facing image and surface; presented form need not collapse into source identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withdrawal from kin first creates a social and geographic separation; the focus barrier then creates a second, local boundary. The eastern setting adds a lightward edge, making the nested concealment also a threshold at which an appearance can emerge.

activation_trace.role: Moving off to a side supplies the outer spatial withdrawal.
The kin-group sense identifies the social field from which the outer withdrawal occurs.
Rising light gives the secluded location an edge of disclosure as well as distance.
Blocked access supplies the inner boundary added after the outer withdrawal.

structural_cues: 19:16 places withdrawal from kin before the focus ayah's local barrier.
The eastern location precedes the sending and manifestation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sideward withdrawal from kin, an eastern site, and then a barrier; I infer nested boundaries and treat the lightward location as disclosure pressure. The eastern detail may instead remain purely locative.

changed_reading.after: The curtain is an inner layer within an already separated site, and that nested privacy becomes the threshold of manifestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The complete human appearance does not invite immediate trust. Mary answers it by seeking divine shelter and conditioning the encounter on moral self-protection, converting the material access barrier into a spoken and ethical boundary.

activation_trace.role: Blocked access supplies the first protective layer.
The unmistakably human presentation supplies the apparent interpersonal risk.
Seeking shelter replaces the crossed physical screen with invoked protection.
Mercy names the protective authority to which the encounter is referred.
Self-placement in protection turns piety into the ethical condition placed on the apparent visitor.

structural_cues: 19:18 is Mary's immediate speech after the represented human appears.
The refuge invocation and the piety condition occur in one defensive utterance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a crossed screen, a complete human appearance, refuge, and a piety condition; I infer that Mary's utterance functions as a second boundary. It may also be read more narrowly as alarm without a general boundary mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The barrier is breached when the human figure appears.
changed_reading.after: Protection changes medium: after visual access occurs, Mary actively re-establishes control through refuge and an ethical condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The represented figure identifies its function as message-bearing, then names a gratuitous grant whose outcome is a pure child. This makes the focus embodiment an intermediate delivery interface in a sender-to-recipient-to-gift sequence, not the terminal object of the scene.

activation_trace.role: Life-bearing spirit supplies the sent agency at the head of the sequence.
The fashioned presentation supplies the temporary human-facing interface.
Explicit messenger identity fixes the appearance's communicative office.
A gift without exchange defines the transfer carried by the messenger.
Purity qualifies the promised outcome and separates it from the messenger's borrowed appearance.

structural_cues: 19:19 directly follows Mary's challenge and supplies both identity and purpose.
The grammatical sequence moves from messenger to grant to child.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-identification as messenger and a stated grant; I infer a delivery pipeline in which the focus form mediates rather than causes the promised outcome. A narrower alternative is that human form only enables dialogue.

changed_reading.before: A spirit arrives in human form.
changed_reading.after: A sent agency adopts a human interface to announce and mediate a gift whose outcome is distinct from that interface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same human category used for the focus appearance is repeated under explicit negation of human sexual contact, with transgression separately denied. The represented class is therefore staged as the ordinary causal explanation only to be blocked; resemblance and generative causation are decoupled.

activation_trace.role: Image-like presentation establishes likeness without yet establishing ordinary causation.
The human category names the class that the appearance visibly occupies.
Negated sexual contact removes the ordinary embodied causal route.
Repetition of the human category explicitly identifies the excluded causal class.
Negated sexual misconduct closes the alternative route of human transgression.

structural_cues: 19:20 repeats the focus human noun inside a negated contact construction.
A second negation denies sexual transgression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human likeness followed by no human contact and no sexual misconduct; I infer that the repeated human category works as a negative causal control. Mary's words may primarily express her own uncertainty, but the contrast still separates appearance from ordinary cause.

changed_reading.before: Human form suggests a human causal agent.
changed_reading.after: The form makes the excluded ordinary cause visible as a likeness; it does not supply the human contact that the next ayah expressly denies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The encounter begins behind a human-facing barrier but is directed toward becoming an evident sign for people and a mercy, with the outcome executed as a settled act. Manifestation is thus the first conversion of a private event into public legibility.

activation_trace.role: Prevented access supplies the private starting condition.
A fashioned visible presentation begins the movement toward legibility.
An evident sign supplies the intended public mode of the outcome.
Human society supplies the audience beyond Mary's secluded space.
Mercy gives the public sign a beneficent social function.
Executed and perfected action supplies firmness to the private-to-public transition.

structural_cues: 19:21 explicitly assigns the outcome to people beyond Mary.
The sign, mercy, and settled matter occur in one purpose-and-completion sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seclusion, visible presentation, a sign for people, mercy, and settled execution; I infer a designed conversion from private encounter to public evidence. The sign may refer only to the eventual child rather than to the focus manifestation as its first stage.

changed_reading.before: The manifestation resolves a private encounter.
changed_reading.after: The manifestation initiates a process by which a screened private event is made socially legible as a public sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: After a human-shaped messenger speaks inside seclusion, Mary closes her own speech channel to humans, communicates by gesture, and directs attention to a child from whom speech is considered impossible. The sequence repeatedly separates message, visible bearer, and expected speaker.

activation_trace.role: The first fashioned human presentation establishes mediated communication.
Humans are the audience from whom Mary's direct verbal channel is withdrawn.
Restraint of the tongue creates a communicative barrier rather than a visual one.
Intelligible speech names the channel Mary explicitly closes.
A bodily gesture redirects the audience without reopening Mary's speech.
The group's speech-question foregrounds the apparently impossible new speaker.
The prepared place for an infant makes the redirected speech source maximally unexpected.

structural_cues: 19:26 closes Mary's speech specifically toward humans.
19:29 replaces her speech with pointing, and 19:30 answers through first-person speech from the indicated child.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speaking human presentation, Mary's silence, gesture, an objection to infant speech, and the infant's reply; I infer deliberate channel rerouting. The episodes can also be read as separate miracles without a shared communication architecture.

changed_reading.before: Human form is adopted only to permit the initial conversation.
changed_reading.after: The focus appearance begins a wider pattern in which messages travel through unexpected human surfaces while expected speakers or channels are closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later predicates arrange beneficence, non-coercion, safety, and a straight path around the child. They reactivate the focus adjective's branch that spans straightness and completeness in both formation and character, allowing bodily coherence to carry an exploratory ethical-directional resonance.

activation_trace.role: Straight and complete formation provides the focus hinge from morphology toward ordered character.
Relational goodness supplies a positive ethical axis.
Negated coercive force supplies the rejected deformation of agency.
Safety and freedom from harm supply wholeness across the life sequence.
The straight road externalizes rectitude as direction.
Straightness, balance, and uprightness reinforce the path's ordered quality.

structural_cues: 19:30-33 gives the child an extended ethical and life-course self-description.
19:36 closes the unit with an explicitly straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete formation, moral predicates, and a straight path; I carry straightness analogically from form into agency and direction. The live alternative is to keep the focus adjective strictly physical and assign the later ethics only to the child.

changed_reading.before: Complete human form describes only visual and bodily normality.
changed_reading.after: Complete form can also prefigure ordered agency and straight direction, provided that extension is kept exploratory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus assigns taking to Mary and sending to the divine speaker. Later, the same taking lexeme is explicitly denied for divine acquisition of offspring, while decisive making supplies the alternative. This calibrates roles: a human takes a screen for use; God sends and effects, but does not appropriate a child as kin.

activation_trace.role: Making something for oneself defines Mary's local instrumental acquisition.
Sending and release define the divine action in the focus sequence.
The same acquisitive branch is negated when offspring is its object and God its subject.
Offspring and descent identify the kinship relation expressly excluded from divine taking.
Perfected execution supplies the productive divine alternative to acquisitive kinship.

structural_cues: 19:35 repeats the focus taking derivation but changes subject and object under negation.
The ayah follows the negation with decree, speech, and becoming rather than filial acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Mary's taking, divine sending, denied divine taking of offspring, and decisive execution; I infer deliberate role calibration that guards the focus possessive and human appearance from kinship collapse. The repetition may also be incidental lexical reuse within a broader doctrinal correction.

changed_reading.before: The focus possessive and human-shaped spirit can be read without attention to acquisition categories.
changed_reading.after: The focus carefully assigns taking to Mary's screen and sending to God; later denial blocks converting the sent human appearance into divine acquisition of offspring.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus crosses a physical veil and achieves visible human presentation, yet later parties divide, cover the truth, and remain heedless even amid manifest error until a day of witnessing and sight. Sensory availability and epistemic recognition are separate thresholds.

activation_trace.role: A screening partition supplies the physical visibility threshold.
A visible fashioned presentation solves sensory access but not interpretation.
Covering truth supplies an epistemic veil that can survive physical manifestation.
Presence with witnessing supplies the later condition of unavoidable disclosure.
Direct seeing marks the later sensory clarity contrasted with present error.
Manifest disclosure intensifies the paradox that visible evidence can coexist with error.
Unawareness supplies the cognitive barrier left in place after sensory presentation.

structural_cues: 19:37 places group division before a future scene of witnessing.
19:38 contrasts future hearing and seeing with present manifest error, and 19:39 names present heedlessness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a crossed screen, visible presentation, truth-covering, later witnessing and sight, manifest error, and heedlessness; I infer two thresholds, sensory access and recognition. The later judgment language may function independently rather than commenting on the focus manifestation.

changed_reading.before: Once the hidden agent appears in complete human form, concealment has ended.
changed_reading.after: Physical concealment ends, but interpretive concealment can persist; manifestation makes something visible without guaranteeing that its role is recognized.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus barrier's internal-body branch and links it to pregnancy, labor, and ripening. It remains anchored in the focus sequence of enclosure, life-bearing spirit, image, and complete formation, but downstream prose must present it only as a material analogy, not claim that the screen is literally a womb or identify the spirit with reproductive substance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 4, 7-11 can be carried as enclosure, animation, formation, visible surface, and completion.

activation_trace.role: An internal bodily partition supplies the enclosure or membrane image.
Life-bearing spirit supplies animation entering the enclosed process.
A fashioned image supplies transition from hidden agency toward visible form.
Complete formation supplies the mature endpoint of the analogy.
Internal carrying makes the post-encounter process explicitly gestational.
Labor disturbance turns containment into a process producing emergence.
Ripe fruit supplies a parallel image of completed maturation.
Taking produce from its place supplies emergence into obtainable outcome.

changed_reading.before: The barrier is only defensive architecture around a visitation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the barrier can also mark an incubation threshold through which life-bearing agency moves toward complete visible outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads book, recollection, embodied image, gesture, and speech as successive media in one relay. Exact branch and sequence anchors keep it live, but downstream prose should call it a formal communication analogy, not assert that embodiment is literally writing or that all media are equivalent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus representation at word 8 and human surface at word 10 sit between a written recollection before it and gesture-plus-speech after it.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something back into active awareness opens the communication relay.
Organized letters and the written object supply the first explicit medium.
A fashioned image converts the relay from written remembrance into embodied visibility.
Human surface supplies the visible carrier of the embodied message.
Gesture shifts the relay into nonverbal bodily indication.
Intelligible speech names the channel expected to complete interpersonal transfer.
The written medium returns inside the child's speech, closing the relay without collapsing its stages.

changed_reading.before: The represented body is an isolated visual miracle.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the human presentation is one medium in a relay from recorded remembrance through image and gesture to renewed speech about a book.

strongest_changes: The human-shaped appearance becomes a messenger interface rather than an ordinary human cause.
Mary's barrier remains active by changing from spatial exclusion into invoked, ethical, and communicative boundary control.
A screened private encounter begins a process aimed at a public sign for people.
The repeated taking lexeme distinguishes Mary's instrumental acquisition from denied divine acquisition of offspring.
Visible manifestation solves sensory access but not epistemic recognition.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly separates appearance, causation, ownership, and communication: the spirit appears human while human contact is negated; barriers reroute access rather than merely fail; and taking a screen, sending a messenger, and not taking offspring receive sharply different roles.
remaining_uncertainties: The eastern-light threshold may be only a locative detail.
Extending complete formation into ethical straightness is licensed by the branch inventory but remains analogical.
The gestational-enclosure and cross-media readings should remain contained exploratory models.
